children: VDA President Hildegard Mueller said on Thursday that if market distortions arise from conduct that violates World Trade Organization rules, the EU has WTO-compliant instruments at its disposal to ensure a level playing field.
"Isolationism and protectionist measures always carry the risk of escalating trade disputes," Mueller said.
